assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite for a compact top-down roguelike dungeon, viewed from slight front/top, same chunky simplicity as image 1 (style reference sheet). One isolated object, true transparent background. Deliberately coarse pixel art: large square pixels, hard edges, 2-3 flat shades per material, dark outline. No gradients, glow, antialiasing, micro-detail, pedestal shadow outside silhouette, text, people, scenery. Designed to remain readable on a 16x32 logical pixel grid. Image 2 is mood reference only: underground chained prison. Make a low wide iron and charcoal stone prison arch, sparse dark red seal at top, two short broken chain sections on shoulders. Opening completely empty and transparent through to bottom; no door leaves, no threshold across bottom. Symmetric chunky gray uprights. Arch spans 48x24 logical pixels. Restrained practical dungeon architecture, not grand cathedral.
